h:
这是一个支持 LoRA 的 SDXL/PonyXL 的 9 列提示网格。它根据 1 个种子和您输入的 9 个提示生成 9 个图像。每列都有一个开/关切换，以防您不需要使用所有列。我用它来：

- 测试某些单词的权重，例如 muscular 到 (muscular:1.2) 到 (muscular:1.4)。

-了解形容词和否定词如何影响同一提示。

- 我最喜欢的是将提示行分为 9 个不同的组，看看哪个顺序最好。我使用 ChatGPT 来为我洗牌：

请将以下几行内容随机分为 9 个不同的组（包括逗号）：
鳄鱼_邓迪，
殴打袋鼠，
在拳击场上，
动态、动作、纪录片、

o.en:
This is a 9 column prompt grid for SDXL/PonyXL with LoRA support. It generates 9 images based on 1 seed and the 9 prompts that you enter. It has an on/off toggle for each column in case you don't need to use all of them. I use it to:

-Test the weight of certain words, like muscular to (muscular:1.2) to (muscular:1.4).

-See how adjectives and negatives affect the same prompt.

-And my favorite, shuffling the lines of a prompt into 9 different groups to see which order turns out the best. I use ChatGPT to shuffle it for me:

Please take the following lines and shuffle them into 9 different groups, including the commas:
Crocodile_Dundee,
punching a kangaroo,
in a boxing ring,
dynamic, action, documentary,
